useCases.description: OpenClaw monitors your calendar, researches upcoming meeting attendees via browser control, and posts one-page briefings to your Slack DM before every call. Persistent memory means briefings build on any previous interactions with that account.

useCases.title: Overnight Pipeline Analysis and Deal Alerts
useCases.description: Drop CRM exports into your OpenClaw folder and it analyzes deal health overnight, predicting outcomes, flagging at-risk opportunities, and recommending specific next actions. Prioritized alerts appear in your Slack channel each morning.

useCases.title: Proposal and SOW Drafting from Deal Notes
useCases.description: OpenClaw reads your deal notes and discovery call summaries from local Markdown files and drafts custom proposals, SOWs, and pricing documents. Persistent memory ensures each proposal addresses the specific requirements discussed throughout the sales process.

useCases.title: Competitive Battle Cards via Browser Monitoring
useCases.description: OpenClaw periodically browses competitor websites and generates updated battle cards with feature comparisons, pricing intelligence, and tailored talk tracks. Cards are stored locally and posted to your Slack sales channel whenever competitors make changes.

faq.question: How do I install OpenClaw for my sales team?
faq.answer: OpenClaw is free and open-source (MIT license) with 165K+ GitHub stars. Each rep installs it on their device in under five minutes, connects it to Slack, WhatsApp, and email, and installs sales-specific skills from ClawHub. The guide includes both individual rep setup and team-wide deployment playbooks for sales managers.

faq.question: Will OpenClaw-generated outreach emails end up in spam?
faq.answer: OpenClaw generates emails that sound authentically human because each one is uniquely crafted based on real prospect research via browser control. The guide teaches personalization techniques and sending practices that actually improve deliverability compared to generic mass outreach because no two emails are alike.

faq.question: Can individual reps use OpenClaw or does the whole team need to adopt it?
faq.answer: Individual reps can start using OpenClaw immediately on their own device. The guide also includes team deployment playbooks for sales managers who want to roll out OpenClaw across their organization with shared ClawHub skills, consistent prompt templates stored in persistent memory, and team-wide Slack integrations.

faq.question: How does OpenClaw connect to Salesforce, HubSpot, or other CRMs?
faq.answer: OpenClaw can read CRM data from exported CSVs, use browser control to interact with your web-based CRM directly, and run scripts that call CRM APIs. ClawHub has community skills for Salesforce, HubSpot, and Pipedrive integration. The guide provides step-by-step connection instructions for each major CRM platform.
